Initial release of gigo-lobster-resume

- Adds "resume mode" to continue unfinished runs using old checkpoints from gigo-lobster-taster.
- Supports both Chinese and English trigger phrases (e.g., “继续试吃”, “resume tasting”).
- Automatically detects run language and resumes with the preferred Python command.
- Monitors progress in real time and provides streaming updates; full logs are tailed and never read in bulk.
- Robust error/exit handling; only fails if the process exits abnormally or on explicit user request.
- Default output continues in the original gigo-lobster-taster directory with checkpoint resume.
